members.name: Dr Reginald Nkemadu
members.bio:
Dr. Reginald Nkemadu is the Chairman/Chief Executive of Carlton Group of Companies, an astute administrator and an outstanding nation builder.

Born in Lagos, Nigeria, he hails from Umuhu, Ukpor, Nnewi South Local Government Area of Anambra State. Dr. Nkemadu is highly educated, holding multiple degrees and certificates from institutions including the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), University of Port Harcourt, and George Mason University, Virginia, USA.

He joined the Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) in September 2003 as a Principal Manager in Business Development and became a full Director in June 2019. He has served in strategic roles including Director, Research and Development; Director, Public Affairs; and Deputy Director/Head, Special Intervention Projects.

He is widely traveled, having visited more than thirty countries, and was appointed Vice Chairman of the International Telecommunications Union (ITU) Development Sector Study Group 2 for the Study Period 2018-2021. He is married to Mrs. Wendy Nkemadu, and they are blessed with five children.

members.name: Kamsy Nkemadu
members.bio:
Ms. kamsy Nkemadu is currently pursuing a degree in Public Policy Administration at Miva Open University, where she is developing a strong foundation in global affairs, governance, and diplomacy.

Alongside her academic journey, she has distinguished herself as a seasoned Executive Assistant, consistently demonstrating a commitment to efficiency, excellence, and organizational growth.

Beyond her professional achievements, Patience is deeply devoted to community service. She volunteers with several organizations, most notably the Shepherd's Mentorship Foundation, where she plays a central role in the Child's Safe Space initiative.

As a Board Member of Mary Gold, Patience contributes significantly to shaping programs that empower young people through advocacy, education, and mentorship. Her dedication reflects Mary Gold's commitment to nurturing a generation of proactive, responsible, and socially conscious leaders.

members.name: Somtochukwu Nkemadu
members.bio:
Ms. Somtochukwu Nkemadu is a dedicated and purpose-driven individual committed to making a positive impact in every environment she finds herself. Guided by the core values of excellence, integrity, and service, she consistently strives to deliver outstanding results through every task she undertakes.

With strong skills in System Analysis and Digital Marketing, Mary combines analytical thinking with creativity and strategic insight. Her ability to understand complex systems, align them with user needs, and support digital growth initiatives places her at the intersection of technology and communication.

Mary's overarching goal is to contribute meaningfully to the development of people and organizations by applying her skills, embracing continuous learning, and maintaining an unwavering commitment to excellence. She aspires to be a catalyst for growth, innovation, and positive transformation wherever she goes.
